text.tspan: A small container becomes a VPN router. Every container you plug into

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
text.tspan: its private bridge goes through the VPN, with the kill switch outside

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
text.tspan: the apps, so nothing inside them can route around it.
